evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary capabilities for games (invite/join, browse/view/export/delete), so game creation is supported end-to-end.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists for estimators to use the URL to join the game.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary item lifecycle and participant viewing/estimating capabilities needed for rounds.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capabilities exist to create/add items and manage them (edit/delete/select).

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Items can be created/added and later re-estimated; selection fits within that lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary read/update/delete/select behaviors for items, forming a complete item management set.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists to create/add items that can then be edited.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists to create/add items that can then be deleted.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary estimate collection and default reveal-after-all behavior, so early reveal is an additional supported path.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary capabilities to enter/auto-fill an agreed estimate, supporting completion of a round.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary capability to accept/enter the agreed estimate, so auto-fill is not missing a necessary follow-up step.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary estimate-gathering and reveal behaviors needed before an agreed estimate can be entered.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary capabilities to view/select items and to see prior rounds, enabling re-estimation.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Backlog already supports having items/stories in the session (create/add/list), so import is an additional creation path rather than exposing a missing core capability.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Backlog supports item creation and listing; copy/paste is an alternative input method and does not reveal a missing complementary step.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes game creation and viewing/exporting transcripts, so browsing previous games is supported by existing game persistence features.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes creation and play of games/rounds/items/estimates, which provides the content a transcript would display.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing transcripts and creating the underlying game data; export is a complementary output capability, not missing prerequisites.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing transcripts and creating the underlying game data; export is supported by those complementary stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists to create games that can later be deleted; deletion does not expose a missing creation step.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary login and account maintenance/deletion capabilities, forming a complete account lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists to create an account, which is a prerequisite for login.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists to create an account whose details can then be changed.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists to create an account that can later be deleted.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: This is a cross-cutting display requirement and does not imply a missing complementary CRUD capability elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists for account creation and login; password reminder supports account access rather than exposing a missing prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {…} or {…}
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes core estimating/playing behaviors; choosing a card set is an optional configuration and does not reveal a missing essential complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists for estimators to join via URL; this story refines capacity rather than exposing a missing step.

evaluations.evidence: join a game ... received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists for moderators to invite/share a URL to access the game.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary capability for moderators to create/add/select the current item, enabling estimators to view it.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary capability to create/add and list items, providing the content for this view.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Backlog lacks any story where a participant/estimator actually submits/plays an estimate (selects a card). Many stories assume estimates exist (visibility, change, reveal, accept), but no complementary 'give estimate' capability is present.

evaluations.evidence: after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This story presupposes estimators can 'give their estimate', but the backlog contains no story for submitting/playing an estimate (card selection). Missing complementary capability prevents this feature from being achievable.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate requires an initial capability to place/submit an estimate, which is absent from the backlog. Multiple stories assume estimates exist but none creates them.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates presupposes estimates can be submitted and stored per estimator; the backlog lacks the complementary story for an estimator to give/submit an estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Requires that participants can submit estimates during a round; no story provides the complementary capability to play/submit an estimate.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer functionality is self-contained and does not depend on a missing complementary CRUD capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: This depends on the ability for participants to 'play an estimate' (submit a card), which is missing from the backlog; thus the trigger condition cannot be satisfied.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Requires that estimates exist from prior rounds; backlog lacks the complementary capability for estimators to submit estimates, so there may be no estimates to scroll through.

evaluations.evidence: cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: This is a UI consistency requirement and does not expose a missing complementary capability by itself.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: As with other estimate-change stories, this presupposes an initial estimate submission capability that is absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: This presupposes the existence of 'cards being played' (estimate submission). Since the backlog lacks a story for submitting/playing an estimate, this display feature cannot be fully realized.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Non-functional compliance requirement; does not imply a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Documentation/support story; does not expose a missing complementary capability required for feature completeness of the application.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Implementation detail/performance support; does not indicate a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Compatibility requirement; does not reveal a missing complementary functional step in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility requirement; does not imply missing complementary functional capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement; does not expose a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Internationalization requirement; does not indicate a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Usability/architecture requirement; does not reveal a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error-handling requirement; does not imply missing complementary CRUD/functional steps.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: This presupposes that identifiable results (e.g., per-estimator estimates) are being captured; however, the backlog lacks the complementary capability for estimators to submit estimates in the first place, so the 'results' to store (identifiable or not) are not fully established.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics depend on core usage events (notably estimates being submitted during games). Since the backlog lacks the complementary capability for participants to submit/record estimates, key usage data needed for meaningful metrics is missing.
